text:
maria: Heads-up — kicked off a 10% staged rollout for model v2-q4 (longdoc-optimized). Quick smoke looked okay but A/B telemetry flagged an anomaly on long-context slice (>4k tokens). @sam can you peek at routing? :eyes: 

sam: On it. Shadow logs show hallucination rate +3.2% vs control for prompts >4k. overall latency fine but tail +15ms. linked graph https://dash.example.com/r/abcd1234

alex: Is that the KV-warm cohort we prewarmed? Cold workers could cause odd KV-cache hits with quantized weights.

maria: Yes, KV-warm slice. Not sure why coldpath would increase hallucinations though.

eva-bot: smoke-check: safety gates pass (toxicity, prompt-sanity). fidelity (longdoc-mrr) -0.55ppt on a 5k sample.

jordan: Paste rollout config so we can verify auto-fallback thresholds.

sam: rollout config:
```
rollout: traffic_split=0.10, holdback=0.02, auto_fallback=true, fallback_thresholds: mrr_drop=0.5, halluc_rate_delta=2.0
```

alex: Note: mrr_drop is 0.5ppt and we see 0.55 — auto-fallback would fire if signal is stable on that slice. But sample size is small and noisy.

maria: We only have 5k samples for the slice. Proposal: pause expansion, bump holdback to 20%, and run a 1h seeded smoke with 10k targeted longdocs. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

sam: +1. Also suggest disabling auto-fallback temporarily to avoid flip-flopping while we investigate.

jordan: I'll open an incident-lite so SRE can correlate infra (GPU evictions/ooms) with the spike. cc @alex.

eva-bot: ticket created INF-2026-147 https://tickets.example.com/INF-2026-147

maria: Action list: 1) pause expansion (sam) 2) set holdback -> 20% (sam) 3) disable auto-fallback for v2-q4 (maria) 4) run 1h seeded smoke with 10k longdocs (alex) 5) SRE correlation (jordan). Will update in ~90m. :thumbsup: 

sam: Pause + holdback applied. traffic now 8% -> 2% with v2 pinned holdback 20%. deploy logs confirm. :white_check_mark: 

alex: Starting seeded run, collecting per-slice telemetry. Will attach per-prompt failure examples if pattern emerges. Interim partial results:
```
PROMPT_ID: 9a8b7c
CONTROL: "... summary of chapter 4 ..."
V2-Q4: "... fabricates a minor timeline detail ..."
```

maria: Good. Keep updates here. If delta stays >0.5ppt mrr after full sample we rollback to v2-p1 and redo quant experiments in playground. If noisy, resume gated rollout after 24h.

eva-bot: seeded smoke partial: 2k/10k done. interim mrr delta -0.12ppt, halluc delta +0.9%. continuing...

sam: Confirmed holdback+pause in control plane. logs: deploy-87654.

jordan: SRE will tail GPU eviction + OOM logs for 2h and attach to INF-2026-147.

maria: Thanks. If seeded run reproduces the mrr drop we rollback; otherwise we stabilize the rollout config (increase sample windows, require 10k slice samples before auto-fallback).

alex: Also adding a small experiment: run quantized weights with full-precision KV merge on a 1% debug route to isolate quant or kv interaction.

maria: Good idea. Assign that to sam/playground.

sam: Will spin debug route and report.

maria: Update: seeded run finished. final longdoc-mrr delta: -0.06ppt, halluc delta: +0.8%. Given reduction vs initial smoke I think noise. Re-enabling gated rollout but keep holdback at 15% for 24h and require 10k slice samples to evaluate auto-fallback.

jordan: SRE didn't see correlation with GPU evictions; attach logs to INF-2026-147.

eva-bot: summary:
- initial smoke (5k sample) mrr -0.55ppt triggered alert
- seeded 10k sample showed final mrr -0.06ppt
- action: resume gated rollout, holdback 15% for 24h, auto-fallback requires 10k slice samples
link to runbook: https://runbook.example.com/rollouts#v2-q4

maria: Closing loop. We'll re-run quantization in playground with FP-KV merge and re-evaluate. Thanks all.
